programmes.d: The FBI investigation into McCullough & Associates has completely shut down Lacey's firm and assets. Lacey's convicted felon mother Tony remains in prison.
We catch a glimpse into Ben's childhood; divisions arise.
Chelsea tells Lacey she's secured the meeting with her father, Gov. Barclay, who is the only one who can pardon Tony, but it will cost her. Lacey and Gideon meet to strategize about her defense.
Janice and her children discover their purpose.
Pamela Sanders' family mourn her while dealing with drama.

With Governor Barclay now at her mercy, things start to turn around for Lacey. Britney meets with Alphonso in jail, offers to represent him pro-bono. Judge Sears vents at Peter Corbin's lack of results around Lacey.

Agent Diggs meets with Lacey's enemies, to persuade them to work with the FBI and to testify against Lacey. Big D watches the Governor's insincere speech with contempt as he 'recycles the same bullshit he said 20 years ago.'
Cam Jr. spirals, police close in on the family.
Carissa makes a risky move and Brittany forms an alliance.
Rev. McCullough welcomes back Tony as the First Lady of Holy Spirit church. Meanwhile, during his draft workout for the LA Cheetahs, Frank Marzili advises Savoy not to sign with Daniel McCullough.
An old flame tempts Cam Jr. Carissa's ex-lover.

With the newly acquired security footage from Randall's home, Judge Reinhart grants Lacey and Randall a new trial. Capt. Warren Sloan congratulates Senator James Barclay on winning his special election.
Law enforcement close in on the Sanders banking operation.

Tony escorts Britney into the Warehouse for the first time. Randall and Daniel hold a press conference to announce their new venture. Sasha and Sloan enjoy their first real date as a couple. Lacey and Mark discuss all the issues in their marriage.
Cam Jr. learns the truth about his mother's death.

Judge Sharon Floyd and Big D broker a truce between Judge Sears and Tony. Randall offers to take Daniel under his wing and teach him. Chelsea confronts her father Sen. Barclay about Samantha. Lacey confronts Tony about Tony's new protégé Britney.
Cameron Jr. takes his best shot at Carissa.
Dr. Draya Logan develops a selacious but exciting case study of three desperate housewives with deadly repercussions.
Peter faces the sins of his past.
Draya tries to pry information from Gina as she falls deeper into her web of lies with Julio and Alejandro.
Triva makes her move on Torrance. Alexis and Summer arrive.
The penthouse gets more action when Syleena and Terrell introduce their masquerade parties, but not before Draya spots a guest that could jeopardize everything.
Carissa's surprise. Alexis is the new matriarch.
Still unable to break her shell, Draya dives deeper into Jordan and her many secrets.
Cameron Sr. confronts his son about his secrets.
Syleena gets a visit from her past, causing she and Terrell to seek a huge favor from Mona Dee; Draya finds drugs at the penthouse.
A spiraling Draya gets a visit from her past; Syleena puts a plan into place to recoup Mona Dee's money.
The wedding date finally arrives.
Draya finds out that even a therapist needs a therapist when Dr. Serena pays her an unexpected visit; The ladies are being blackmailed at the penthouse.
Brittany senses a rift within her love triangle.
After her visit with Dr. Serena, Draya is ready to end the penthouse project, but not before more drama ensues.
Carissa is tormented by her ugly past.
Left to rot, Dr. Draya Logan is on a mission to gain her freedom while simultaneously keeping tabs on Gina, Jordan, and Syleena.
Law enforcement starts to close in on the family's crimes.
Draya gives Mayor Dupri an ultimatum that could grant her the freedom she desires, changing everything for the women.
Jupiter goes to Nigeria for peace. Carissa and Dante bond.
Draya is back, and trying to move on, but finds herself revisiting her past life when she gets a special visitor.
Sammy's pressured while his protege makes moves.
Draya finds herself back into the arms of Maxwell while everything starts to crumble for the women.
Eileen's enraged and Torrance spirals further.
When Draya finds out what Linc has done to Jordan, she rallys the women together for a fail proof plan involving Mona Dee.
Cameron Jr. must sacrifice his business ideas for family.
In the midst of planning for her new show, Draya finds herself at odds with the one person who has had her back through it all.
The walls begin to close in on the Sanders family.
Draya finds herself at the front of the biggest night of Clair's career and the creation of a super intense plan that could free herself and the girls forever.
Carissa finds herself stewing in a cell.
Draya's Big Night has arrived with the live taping premiere of The Dr. Draya Show while the women execute the plan to take Linc out.
Carissa tries to offset her evil acts with a good deed.
The Women struggle with a lack of revenue. Natasha makes a sweet deal to avoid a pitfall on a big case. Miranda falls in love with Tina's ex fiancée who is also her dentist.
Stephanie begins to make her move.

A huge movie star comes to the office to defend himself against allegations of misconduct involving a hot young actress. Tina works on her Facebook obsession. Trixie receives a prophecy from the heavens above.
Cameron Sr. gets a surprise visit from Minister Ponce.
Natasha plans the first annual Woman's Appreciation Day with the girls. A vicious war erupts with the female lawyers next door over Natasha's missing lucky stapler.
Miranda believes that she may be pregnant. The girls attend mothering classes. Tina decides to compete for a good-looking man's affections by getting serious about fitness.
Cutter fails at his latest murder attempt.
Natasha is smitten by a handsome tow truck driver named Hands. Trixie struggles with anger management.
Cameran Sr. kicks his son out of the house.
Natasha's big limbo cruise ship trial begins. A judge tries to get close to Trixie.

If a case or situation doesn't go her way, Lacey won't hesitate to trade on her discretion with her service, whether in law enforcement or the private sector. She's mastered the art of the deal, but as she builds influence, she's also making rivals on both sides of the law. A loyal staff and tunnel
Dante and Carissa strike. Alexis admonishes Cameron Sr.

Othello and the twin enforcers meet with the billionaire husband of Daniel's alleged rape victim. Britney gets a call in the middle of the night that leads to an horrifying discovery. Daniel despairs in county lockup while Lacey and her team try to post bail.
Carissa fights for her life... and her future.

An unnerved Lacey goes to the county jail, only to make a shocking discovery. Othello goes the extra mile to get leverage for a client who's getting lowballed on a mega-real estate deal isn't working out.
Lacey takes on a new case, but has ulterior motives. Daniel tells Lacey about a possible new witness, but Lacey doubts his credibility.
After a unsuccessful night, 4 friends separate to explore.

Othello secures another win for the firm, but when he gets too close to Lacey, things don't go as expected.
